summary: BOXABL Inc. filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, announcing an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with Virtu Americas, A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, Cohen & Company Capital Markets, Maxim Group, and Roth Capital Partners, permitting sales of up to $100,000,000 in Class A common stock from time to time. The agents receive commissions up to 3.0% of gross proceeds plus up to $75,000 in reimbursed expenses. This is an ordinary shelf takedown facility, not a special situation, with no board recommendation, premium, or deal terms beyond the aggregate offering cap. Watch for dilution and the pace of any future sales.
